programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marriages with blended families have a higher rate of divorce than the first trip down the aisle, and today’s guests say they know exactly why. When Kip married Vicky, he says he knew that her daughter, Tory, was part of the package. Now, he struggles to get along with the 17-year- old, and they often engage in jaw-dropping screaming matches followed by a month without speaking. Hear the scathing remarks that Dr. Phil describes as the most inappropriate comments that he’s ever heard a stepparent say about a child. What led someone to fear for Tory’s safety and make a worried call to authorities? What, if any, ownership do this teen and her mother have in this family dynamic? And, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters, one of whom has run away. Can this family finally have a happy ending?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad. Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.desc: Pim y Pom, dos gatitos, llevan a los niños a una aventura en el fascinante mundo del arte. Con la fuerza de su imaginación, exploran cuadros de artistas famosos como Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt, Seurat y Renoir.

programme.title: Las aventuras de los bebés llorones Lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Los Bebés Llorones viven en el mundo de Lágrimas Mágicas donde aprenden juntos lo que es la amistad, el trabajo en equipo y la empatía. programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.desc: Pim y Pom, dos gatitos, llevan a los niños a una aventura en el fascinante mundo del arte. Con la fuerza de su imaginación, exploran cuadros de artistas famosos como Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt, Seurat y Renoir.

programme.title: Las aventuras de los bebés llorones Lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Los Bebés Llorones viven en el mundo de Lágrimas Mágicas donde aprenden juntos lo que es la amistad, el trabajo en equipo y la empatía. Disfruta con ellos aventuras increíbles en mundos llenos de magia. Cada uno de los Bebés Llorones es único, pero todos tienen algo en común: ¡sus lágrimas son mágicas!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: The Glass House
programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

programme.desc: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Mushrooms and eggs. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares baked eggs with mushrooms and a spring frittata (Italian egg-based dish), with lots of greens (dandelion, arugula, spinach). Discovery of the day: artisanal mate, a drink that is all the rage.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: To entertain simply and stylishly, the chef offers a menu featuring haddock poached in coconut milk and a crunchy salad.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Vincent Labergère est producteur de Sauternes ; Émilie et Michel Dudon sont éleveurs de volailles en plein air. En compagnie d'Adrien Billotte et Pierre Cante, tout savoir sur le bombage et la cartographie, pour lutter contre la flavescence dorée.

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: What can you do if you have been too heavy-handed with the spices? Don't panic, the team is there to try to rise to the challenge and save your dish.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)
programme.desc: How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: SAVOURER S03 / SRC
programme.desc: A different approach to eating thanks to healthy recipes, organisational tips and ecological ideas from the nutritionist Geneviève O'Gleman and her team.

programme.desc: For the first time, Charles-Antoine chairs a pie contest in Abercorn, with a special guest. Before that, he installs reclaimed planters and receives the beehives from his friend Anicet.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: April Fools fish. Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a fish ceviche with leche de tigre, a more complex mixture than lime juice, followed by fish paupiettes wrapped in chard leaves, steamed. Discovery of the day: chard táchon.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Ricardo joins Isabelle to celebrate bread in all its forms: a savory garlic version, perfect for sharing, and a brioche variation with chocolate, cranberries, and ginger.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Romain Boulet est éleveur de moutons boulonnais ; Loïc Cheuva est directeur de l'association Atelier Cré'Actif sur la cressonnière d'Enquin-sur-Baillons. Sortie nature dans les marais, avec la guide nature Caroline Géneau. Découverte du cap Blanc-Nez, avec Martha Coquet, animatrice d'Eden62.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)

programme.desc: Will the ancestral barn be able to host the country-style dining project in Abercorn? An architect gives her opinion. Sébastien and Charles-Antoine launch their aquaponics system, drawing inspiration from their visit to the Kenauk fish farm.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Chalet barbecue. Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares an original menu with split pea hummus, risoni tabbouleh and barbecued grilled octopus. Discovery of the day: Fribourg burrata with double cream.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: The chef draws inspiration from classic desserts and presents a simplified version of the Black Forest cake. Perfect for impressing guests on special occasions.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Rencontre avec le viticulteur Pierre Dubreuil et la productrice de plantes aromatiques Véronique Briday. Découverte de la microfaune souterraine avec les spéléologues Josiane et Bernard Lips. Animation scolaire avec Marion Crampette, de l'association du réseau des Rivières Sauvages.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)

programme.desc: The aquaponics system is up and running at the Earthship, while piles are installed to reinforce the extension. Charles-Antoine visits his family in Mirabel. He also drops by to see his favourite market gardener, Jean-Pierre Bertrand.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Isabelle creates a salmon tart inspired by bagels and deconstructs the famous lemon tart into bars.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Long live legumes. On the menu: lentils papet vaudois style and crispy chickpeas for the aperitif. Discovery of the day: Geneva longeole cooked on the plancha. Annick Jeanmairet is once again assisted by comedian Brigitte Rosset.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Valentin Fleytoux et Rodolphe Dieudonné sont producteurs fermiers de cancoillotte ; Camille Ponnelle et Xavier Mariot sont agriculteurs et produisent des huiles. Réhabilitation de la rivière La Linotte avec Guillaume Blondel-Gaborieau, ingénieur et maire de Loulans-Verchamp. Cueillette sauvage et réintroduction d'essences locales avec Adrien Léturgie, de l'association FNE 70.

programme.desc: It is time to put the finishing touches on the garage with its tyre foundation, which will be topped with a green roof. His friend Jean-Nick Trudel comes to lend a hand. Meanwhile, Charles-Antoine embarks on an incredible adventure: tuna fishing in Gaspésie.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: The chef welcomes Luca Cianciulli, owner of Moccione and Moccione Pizza. Together, they prepare a grilled flank steak with rosemary, served with lime salsa verde and a potato salad.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Olive oil in pastries, sweet and savoury. Still accompanied by comedian Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet offers a Spanish recipe for sweet anise and sesame biscuits, and a leek quiche. The doughs are made with olive oil. Discovery of the day: Vaud almonds.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Rencontre avec Denis Lesgourgues, producteur d'armagnac ; avec Isabelle et Patrick Collomb, producteurs de légumes bios. Observation de la migration des oiseaux sur l'étang du Moura avec Nicolas Bernadicou. Visite de la Palmeraie du Sarthou avec Daniel Fort. Détour par Elusa, capitale gallo-romaine.

programme.desc: The journey in Gaspésie continues. Will a Bluefin tuna be caught? We follow the path of this majestic fish, from processing in Gaspésie to the plate in Québec City. At the Earthship, the masonry heater begins to take shape.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Soup can be served as a starter or a main dish. To vary the pleasures, Isabelle offers a creamy version with fennel and leftover cooked chicken, and another with spaghetti squash.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet vous propose une chakchouka, sorte de compotée de tomates et de poivrons, avec des oeufs et des herbes, et des aubergines façon tomates farcies. Découverte du jour : l'art du service à table, en compagnie d'un champion qui officie au Domaine de Châteauvieux.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: Sébastien Lys pêche le mulet à l'oeil et à l'écoute ; Brice Thomas partage sa passion pour la production de sel. Ramassage d'oeufs de raies avec l'association IODDE. Raphaël Musseau, docteur en écologie, et Jean-Claude Barbraud, ornithologue au Muséum national d'histoire naturelle, suivent les cigognes blanches. Visite de Marans.

programme.desc: In Abercorn, all the projects have been completed, or almost! Meanwhile, a new morel mushroom cultivation project is taking shape... At Montréal Plaza, the tenth anniversary celebration takes place.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Two recipes on the menu: rigatoni with mushrooms and almonds, and pan-seared salmon with ginger and maple sauce.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07
programme.desc: Premières recettes mitonnées par Annick Jeanmairet, accompagnée de Simon Romang : une couronne des rois et des moules poiré gingembre.

programme.desc: Christian welcomes actor Marc-André Grondin, writer Chrystine Brouillet, and chef Jean-Michel Leblond to cook foods considered 'unappetizing.' From offal to snails, they explore unusual flavors.

programme.title: Toxic Friendz

As the night goes along, debauchery ensues, revealing secrets and revelations about herself. Reality blurs, friendships shatter, but who’s the real villain?

programme.title: Kinfolk
programme.desc: Eboni, is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown. Her feuding family complicates her plans, but her dedication and drive, along with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Meanwhile, their estranged father's attempts to reconcile with his past create further challenges.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: South Side Hero
programme.desc: After serving a 10-year sentence on a RICO charge, reformed gangster Tommy ‘Ace’ Crown returns home to find his 15-year old daughter Sierra missing after she ran away with a man she met online. When the police decline to help, Ace is determined to track her down himself.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: Too Little Too Late
programme.desc: James “Honcho” Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan “Rain” Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. Driven by jealousy, love and money, Rain sets her sights on taking what’s hers, causing Honcho to lose more than just his position. Can she afford the cost to be boss?

programme.title: Tiffany the Doll
programme.desc: She's the perfect partner, she can fulfill your every fantasy, and she's all yours for a price. The newest toy, Tiffany, is no ordinary sex doll, but you have to play to find out.

programme.title: Bruised
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Kayla Brown discovers that her perfect husband is not who she thought he was. Fearing for her life, she must do the unthinkable to end her nightmarish marriage, SHE MUST KILL HIM.

programme.title: When Girls Ride
programme.desc: When Samantha leaves the South to have a fresh start with her husband, she ends up meeting two biker girls named Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close, and decide to start their own women's bike club. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a girl from their group to violence. The women respond accordingly in order to get justice for their friend.

programme.title: Misfortune
programme.desc: When tragedy hits, Rachel is left with more than regret, leaving her bound to a wheelchair and her best friend Sammy's brother Brian with a brain injury. Looking for a new outlook on life, Rachel finds comfort in a new home with more than she bargained for in the form of a fortune teller arcade game, offering her one wish. Will she succeed in bringing her friends back from a detrimental past or will it be misfortune for them all?

programme.title: Deceptive Touch
programme.desc: Cam believes she’s finally found “The One” in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant’s past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: When returning home for Thanksgiving, Elliot, tries to keep cool with his meddlesome, dysfunctional family.

programme.title: Curse of a Father
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Bloodline Secrets
programme.desc: Thirty-three-year-old Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he’s ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha’s faithfulness. When family secrets come out of the shadows, it puts their marriage and lives in jeopardy.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A scheming widow hatches a bold plan to acquire her late husband's inheritance, unaware that she is being targeted by an ax murderer who lurks in the family's estate.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: The Day Time Ended
programme.desc: Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. In the neighbourhood, Gaetano, known as Core e' Fierro, is the absolute boss of the guapperia. A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. After many denials, driven by necessity, Nicola agrees to become a guappo in turn during an initiation at the secret court to which he is introduced by Core e' Fierro. Lucia, Gaetano's woman, feels attracted to Nicola, but the two repress their desire. Ajossa wants to get his hands on Gaetano and sets a trap for Lucia, inducing her to yield to him in order to save her lover, so that the latter, in order to avenge the offence, will make a mistake.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. Dr Mark Putland tries to help a car crash patient, but the man appears to be hiding something suspicious in his underpants. Dr Miriam Yassa examines a cheerful 82-year-old biker with fractures, who suddenly takes a turn for the worse. Dr Emma West’s road trauma victim could have internal bleeding, but the cure could do more harm than good. Nurse Yasna Cardoza helps a patient who collapses after cutting his thumb on a coffee plunger.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. Dr Jonathan Papson suspects a surf-coach has a shattered leg from a horror car crash, which could spell the end of the young man’s career. A worker is in agony after a fall on the job, and Dr Sarah Whitelaw and nurse Maddy Whyte fear he has serious spinal injuries. Dr Mya Cubitt heals a former boxer with neat stitches and helps him confront an unpleasant truth.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. A gunshot victim has Dr Michael Dunne on high alert, as he examines the man’s bullet-riddled body for injuries. Dr Emma West treats a mum who could lose her fingers after a high-speed car crash. Dr Mya’s patient is in agony after falling from a shipping container. Dr Michelle Thornhill stitches up a young man who walked into a wall while checking his phone.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. Dr Sarah Whitelaw’s motorcyclist collided with a car and went head-first through a window, and there are grave fears for his brother who was also on the bike. Dr Mya Cubitt’s scared patient has an unstoppable nosebleed, and security crash-tackles a violent man trying to smear blood onto staff.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Steve Pincus’s young patient could lose his hand after a shocking abattoir accident. A severe asthmatic struggles to breathe, but Dr Bjorn Makein suspects another trigger. Air ambulance delivers a quad-bike rider who crashed at high speed, landing on his head, and Dr Michael Dunne fears there could be spinal injuries. Nurse Lucy Stranger’s detective skills and charm are needed for a patient with chest pains. A wayward spider sends a high-speed road crash victim to Dr Jana Alexander.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A life hangs in the balance, as Dr Emma West rushes to meet a critically injured road trauma victim at the helipad. Every moment counts, as the unconscious patient has severe blood loss. Dr Lauren Cohen treats an American schoolboy who plunged 10 metres down a cliff. 20-year-veteran Dr Tom Razga treats the ‘walking wounded’ in triage, reassuring a highly anxious woman who has a small wound. Is Dr Michelle Thornhill’s patient constipated from pasta or is it more serious?

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A heavily pregnant young woman has collapsed at a train station platform, falling face-first and landing on her stomach. Dr Miriam Yassa is on high alert for the baby’s welfare, and the cause of the mum-to-be’s collapse. Dr Sarah Whitelaw treats a cyclist after a car hit him from behind. He can’t remember the accident or feel his feet. Support volunteer Jean is on hand for comfort and cups of tea and is a welcome distraction for stressed patients.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s paramedics fight to save lives in a race against time. Every second counts as new partners Mike and Eamon treat the teenage victims of a brutal assault. Intensive Care Paramedic Al races to the scene of a motorbike accident, where a tourist’s life hangs in the balance after colliding with a fallen tree. Flight Paramedic Ray treats an unlucky gardener with a shocking injury, but will the helicopter flight make his condition worse? And its all about the love for Taz and Amanda.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda and Taz help a little patient who’s had a big fall. A shocking motorcycle accident in the high country leaves a family man in critical condition. Can surgery in the back of an ambulance keep him alive? Single responder Cam races to help a baby arriving in a hurry. Mike and Eamon respond to an emergency at the city’s busiest railway station, where a man who’s already survived six heart attacks is in a bad way.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Experienced paramedics Doddsy and Carina rush to help a horse trainer who’s in critical condition after being kicked in the face. Matt and the Air Ambulance crew attempt a difficult winch rescue to help a paraglider who has crashed in remote bushland. An out-of-control patient at a busy train station puts Taz and Amanda to the test. Newlywed Leonard has some exciting news to share, before he and Nat rush to help a newborn baby caught in a hit and run.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Taz and Amanda help a patient who has mysteriously collapsed at work in front of panicked customers. Flight Paramedic Ray rushes to help a young mother who has been badly injured in a high impact road accident, and is desperate to find her baby girl. It’s a race against time for Eamon and Mike as they rush to get a first-time mother to hospital before she gives birth. With a 40-kilometre journey ahead of them and contractions speeding up, will Eamon have to deliver the baby?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Single responder Cullen races to the scene of a road accident, where a motorcyclist is unconscious and fighting for his life. Carina and Doddsy battle heavy traffic to save a child’s life, as his distraught mother performs CPR on the side of the road. Taz and Amanda treat a dog bite victim who becomes unpredictable. MICA paramedic Glenice hikes to reach an injured teenager, after a selfie expedition on a stretch of rugged coastline ends in disaster.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda and Nicola rush to help to a terrified woman who is having a major heart attack. Medication will buy them time, but surgery is the only thing that can save her life. Leonard and Nat are called to a major traffic accident where a trapped driver is showing worrying signs of a devastating head injury. Doddsy and Carina treat a mountain bike rider with shocking facial injuries. Eamon and Mike play referee between an embarrassed allergy patient and his protective Mum.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Can Cam’s detective skills crack a critical case and help a young man with severe chest pain? A nervous drive to hospital for Leonard and Amanda, who’s laid back patient has major problems. Nicola and Risky are baffled by a woman’s bizarre symptoms. An out of control heart rate puts a Mum of 5 in the danger zone, and Ray helps a young woman who has been in a major car accident on a country road.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Amanda has a surprise in store to celebrate Taz’s ten years in the service, but the party is on hold as they rush to help a patient who’s had a fall. Cam answers a dangerous callout to save a man in personal crisis. Carina and Doddsy are on edge as they treat a woman who’s suffering a severe allergic reaction after being stung by a bee. Mike and Eamon’s concerns grow for a newlywed couple who've been thrown from their motorbike. Ray heads bush to help a dirtbike rider in trouble.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A bumpy ride as Amanda and Taz rush to a foster Mum in agony. Flight paramedic Matt races to help a teenage student in a critical condition after high jump practice ends in disaster. Can Nat and Leonard convince their laid back patient to come to hospital, after tests show he may be suffering a ‘silent’ heart attack? Eamon works his charms on a distressed cyclist who’s had a run in with a classic Melbourne hazard. Cullen attends an horrific car accident that’s left a young driver trapped.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A gripping emergency airlift for a woman who’s suffered a massive stroke. Risky and Nicola assess a great grandmother in serious pain, but what’s causing it? programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat.
